capability_declaration.evidence: IEC 61850-7-4 (Logical Nodes) and IEC 61850-6 (Configuration description language - SCL)
capability_declaration.rationale: IEC 61850 explicitly defines standardized logical nodes and data models for DER capabilities, enabling devices to declare their functionalities.

bounded_authority.evidence: IEC 61850-7-2 (Abstract Communication Service Interface - ACSI) and IEC 61850-8-1 (MMS mapping)
bounded_authority.rationale: The standard partially addresses authority limits via access control and service constraints, but lacks explicit ceilings, expiry, or revocation mechanisms.

decision_auditability.evidence: IEC 61850-7-2 (Logging and reporting services) and IEC 61850-8-1 (Event and log management)
decision_auditability.rationale: IEC 61850 supports logging and event reporting, but attribution to specific AI agents is not explicitly detailed.

data_governance.evidence: IEC 61850-6 (SCL files for data exchange) and general cybersecurity clauses in IEC 61850-8-1
data_governance.rationale: Data governance is implicitly covered via configuration and cybersecurity clauses, but lacks explicit requirements on ownership, consent, or retention.
